headline: Affle 3i to acquire Israel's Perion Network for $420M in all-cash deal
hook: Strategic buyout expands digital advertising footprint globally

The transaction will be funded entirely in cash, positioning the combined entity for broader global reach in ad tech. Shareholders of Perion Network will receive cash payouts as per the acquisition terms. For Indian retail investors holding Affle (or related entities), this large international buyout signals aggressive overseas expansion that will impact near-term cash reserves.

headline: Affle 3i to acquire Israel's Perion Network for $420 million
hook: Affle expands global footprint in all-cash buy
summary: Affle 3i has announced a definitive agreement to acquire 100% of Israel-based Perion Network for approximately $420 million in an all-cash transaction. Shareholders of Perion will receive $11.70 per share under the deal terms. The acquisition is slated to close by early 2027 and aims to scale Affle's CPCU advertising business into developed markets. Indian retail investors tracking Affle's global expansion will note the long-term strategic reach into international ad-tech sectors.
why_it_matters: Affle's global scale expands its developed markets ad-tech footprint.
winners_losers: Affle shareholders gain / Perion holders exit at cash price

headline: Supreme Court grants stay on NCLT insolvency proceedings against Bobble
hook: Supreme Court pauses Bobble insolvency proceedings
summary: Affle 3i Limited informed the exchange that the Supreme Court of India has granted a stay order on the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) proceedings of Bobble pending before the NCLT. Bobble's insolvency had been moving through tribunal channels. The pause protects the status quo of the company while the legal challenge proceeds in the apex court. Indian retail investors tracking Affle's subsidiaries and legal liabilities should note this judicial intervention.
whats_next: Supreme Court hearings on the Bobble insolvency matter
why_it_matters: Subsidiary legal status pauses, easing immediate insolvency uncertainty for Affle.
